description: A renewable (wind or solar) generator whose output can be curtailed to satisfy system constraints, including proactive curtailment for reserves. For non-curtailable renewables, see RenewableNonDispatch.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

active_power.description: Initial active power set point. The steady-state operating point for power flow; an optional starting point for other solvers. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power.description: Initial reactive power set point of the unit, used in some production cost modeling simulations. To set the reactive power in a load flow, use `power_factor`. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

rating.description: Maximum AC side output power rating of the unit. Not to be confused with base_power. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVA, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

prime_mover_type.description: Prime mover technology according to EIA 923.

reactive_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits, used in some production cost simulations and in power flow when connected to a PV bus. Null if not applicable. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

power_factor.description: Power factor [0, 1] set-point, used in some production cost modeling and in load flow if the unit is connected to a `PQ` bus. Units: 1.

operation_cost.description: Operating cost of generation. or MarketBidCost

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization. Units: MVA.

power_units.description: Unit basis for this component's power fields (power, ratings, ramp rates): COMPONENT_BASE per unit on base_power, NATURAL_UNITS the field's own unit.

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection device, if any.

title: RenewableDispatch
